prompt.en: What usually follows when the party in power loses a vote on a major decision?
prompt.fr: Que se passe-t-il habituellement lorsque le parti au pouvoir perd un vote sur une décision importante?

options.en: The Senate takes over the running of the government until the next election.
options.fr: Le Sénat prend en charge la direction du gouvernement jusqu'à la prochaine élection.

options.en: Nothing changes until the fixed election date in October four years later.
options.fr: Rien ne change jusqu'à la date fixe des élections, en octobre, quatre ans plus tard.

options.en: The Prime Minister usually asks the Governor General to call an election.
options.fr: Le premier ministre demande habituellement au gouverneur général de déclencher une élection.

options.en: The Official Opposition forms a government at once, with no election held.
options.fr: L'Opposition officielle forme aussitôt un gouvernement, sans qu'il y ait d'élection.

explanation.en: A vote on a major issue such as the budget is a test of confidence. Losing it defeats the party in power, and an election usually follows.
explanation.fr: Un vote sur une question importante comme le budget est un test de confiance. Le perdre entraîne la défaite du parti au pouvoir, et une élection suit habituellement.

source.quote: If a majority of the members of the House of Commons vote against a major government decision, the party in power is defeated, which usually results in the Prime Minister asking the Governor General, on behalf of the Sovereign, to call an election.

verification.evidence: When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence. If a majority of the members of the House of Commons vote against a major government decision, the party in power is defeated, which usually results in the Prime Minister asking the Governor General, on behalf of the Sovereign, to call an election.
